templates.title: Release Gate Alert
templates.allowed_use: Notify maintainers when release gate passes or fails.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not expose patient data or clinical conclusions.

templates.title: Stale Artifact Ticket
templates.allowed_use: Create an admin task when critical eval artifacts are stale.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not downgrade safety thresholds or auto-refresh patient-facing outputs.

templates.title: Reviewer Intake Reminder
templates.allowed_use: Send reminder/checklist for external reviewer packets.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not imply clinician approval or clinical validation.

templates.title: Eval Refresh Trigger
templates.allowed_use: Trigger internal eval refresh jobs for synthetic/non-live artifacts.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not trigger clinical actions or use raw patient chat payloads.

templates.title: Synthetic SaaS Workspace Event
templates.allowed_use: Deliver redacted tenant, project, evaluation-job, and usage lifecycle events.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not include patient data, raw prompts, clinical conclusions, or billing claims.

templates.title: Trace Quality Digest
templates.allowed_use: Notify maintainers when trace coverage or trace-envelope validation needs attention.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not send raw prompts, raw responses, private chain-of-thought, or PHI.

templates.title: Pinecone Shadow Report
templates.allowed_use: Send managed-vector shadow retrieval metrics for engineering review.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not promote Pinecone to live retrieval or store patient chat content.

templates.title: External Red-Team Intake
templates.allowed_use: Send no-read red-team packet links and attestation checklist to a reviewer.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not imply clinical validation, clinician approval, or completed external review.

templates.title: Dependency Security Alert
templates.allowed_use: Create an internal ticket for dependency/security-scan findings.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not label dependency scan pass/fail as HIPAA, SOC 2, or healthcare compliance.

templates.title: Deployment Health Alert
templates.allowed_use: Notify maintainers about demo service health and stale engineering artifacts.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not present engineering health as clinical safety or send patient data.

templates.title: High-Priority Conversation Review Alert
templates.allowed_use: Notify an approved internal reviewer channel that a redacted NLCare review item is waiting. Operators may attach an email, SMS, or Viber node after access-control review.
templates.not_allowed_use: Do not send patient identifiers, raw chat text, medical conclusions, or imply that delivery means a clinician saw or acted on the alert.

import_instructions: Import templates manually into n8n; do not commit credentials.
Replace placeholder webhook URLs and notification channels in n8n UI.
Use signed payloads from NLCare when connecting FastAPI to n8n.
Keep workflows admin-only until compliance/security review exists.
claim_boundary: n8n workflow templates are internal automation scaffolds only. They may notify maintainers, create admin tickets, remind reviewers, or trigger internal eval refreshes. They must not send PHI, issue medical advice, override safety validators, or automate diagnosis, treatment, medication, prognosis, genetics, tumor-marker, or clinical-escalation decisions.
